posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
The hint gives you the formula directly.

\text{number of hardlinks} = \text{number of subdirectories} + 2

you can clearly see from output that number of subdirectories = 5.

Thus 5+2=7

This is discussed in details in the PYQ session.
